newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Moslems protest U.S. action against Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Moslems protest U.S. action against Iraq.

text.p: Hong Kong Moslems staged a noisy protest against the United States on Friday for its military manoeuvres against Iraq.

Brandishing placards reading "Washington! Stop interfering in Iraqi Affairs!", "U.S. is a bully", "Respect sovereignty of every country", about 100 protesters denounced what they called U.S. interference in Iraqi affairs.
"The U.S. is killing innocent civilians in their military bombardment. It's unnecessary killing," Mohamed Alli Din, chairman of the United Moslem Association of Hong Kong, told reporters.
U.S. fighter planes and an aircraft carrier are headed to the Gulf for widely expected attacks to punish Iraqi President Saddam Hussein for defying Western patrols of Iraqi air space.
